source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56 (Crop Evapotranspiration - Guidelines for Computing Crop Water Requirements)
reference_table: FAO-56 Table 12: Single (time-averaged) crop coefficients, Kc, and mean maximum plant heights for non-stressed, well-managed crops in subhumid climates
methodology: Kc values represent ratio of crop evapotranspiration (ETc) to reference evapotranspiration (ET0) under standard conditions. Stage-specific adjustments follow FAO-56 dual and single crop coefficient procedures.

initial.label: Sowing / Establishment
initial.description: Germination to early vegetative cover; low transpiration, dominated by soil evaporation.

vegetative.label: Vegetative / Tillering
vegetative.description: Rapid canopy expansion, active root elongation, and tiller development.

flowering.label: Flowering / Heading
flowering.description: Peak water demand; moisture stress at this stage severely curtails grain set.

fruiting.label: Fruiting / Grain Filling
fruiting.description: Milking and dough stage; consistent water supply ensures plump grains.

maturity.label: Ripening / Maturity
maturity.description: Senescence and dry-down; irrigation should cease 10-14 days prior to harvest.

initial.label: Transplanting / Establishment
initial.description: Submerged ponding or high saturation; high evaporation from standing water.

vegetative.label: Active Tillering
vegetative.description: Tillering and panicle development; requires continuous shallow water layer.

flowering.label: Flowering / Panicle Initiation
flowering.description: Critical reproductive window; most sensitive to moisture deficit.

fruiting.label: Grain Filling / Milking
fruiting.description: Nutrient accumulation into kernel; maintain saturated soil.

maturity.label: Maturity / Ripening
maturity.description: Drain fields 10-12 days before harvest to facilitate mechanical cutting.

initial.label: Sowing / Emergence
initial.description: Cotyledon emergence to unifoliate leaf unfolding.

vegetative.label: Vegetative Branching
vegetative.description: Trifoliate leaves unfolding and nodulation initiation.

flowering.label: Flowering / Pod Initiation
flowering.description: Peak water consumption; critical stage for flower retention and pod count.

fruiting.label: Pod Filling / Seed Development
fruiting.description: Seed enlargement within pods; sensitive to drought stress.

maturity.label: Maturity / Harvest
maturity.description: Leaves turn yellow and drop; natural drying of pods.

initial.label: Emergence / Seedling
initial.description: Radicle emergence and early whorl development.

vegetative.label: Knee-High / Stem Elongation
vegetative.description: Vigorous vegetative growth and rapid leaf area accumulation.

flowering.label: Tasseling / Silking
flowering.description: Most critical period; drought stress during silking causes barren cobs.

fruiting.label: Blister / Dough Stage
fruiting.description: Starch deposition into kernels; steady moisture required.

maturity.label: Black Layer / Maturity
maturity.description: Physiological maturity achieved; moisture drops for harvesting.

initial.label: Germination / Emergence
initial.description: Slow early vegetative development with low canopy cover.

vegetative.label: Square Formation / Branching
vegetative.description: Development of floral buds (squares) and monopodial/sympodial branches.

flowering.label: Peak Bloom / Flowering
flowering.description: Maximum water extraction; peak bloom is critical for boll set.

fruiting.label: Boll Development
fruiting.description: Fiber elongation and secondary cell wall thickening inside bolls.

maturity.label: Boll Opening / Harvest
maturity.description: Bolls split open; withhold irrigation to prevent lint discoloration.

initial.label: Transplanting / Establishment
initial.description: Root recovery from nursery transplanting and rosette leaf emergence.

vegetative.label: Vegetative Growth
vegetative.description: Rapid lateral shoot development and first flower truss appearance.

flowering.label: Flowering / Fruit Set
flowering.description: Critical stage; irregular watering causes blossom end rot and flower drop.

fruiting.label: Fruit Enlargement / Ripening
fruiting.description: High water demand; maintain uniform moisture to prevent fruit cracking.

maturity.label: Final Harvest Flushes
maturity.description: Gradual reduction in water requirement as vines exhaust.

initial.label: Seedling / Establishment
initial.description: Transplanted nursery saplings establishing fibrous root spread.

vegetative.label: Branching / Vegetative
vegetative.description: Dichotomous branching and early floral bud initiation.

flowering.label: Flowering / Fruit Set
flowering.description: High sensitivity to water stress; drought causes severe flower drop.

fruiting.label: Green Pod Development
fruiting.description: Pod elongation and capsaicin synthesis; steady irrigation needed.

maturity.label: Red Ripening / Harvesting
maturity.description: Multiple picking flushes; reduce moisture between flushes.

initial.label: Establishment
initial.description: Young seedling acclimation in open field or polyhouse.

vegetative.label: Vegetative Canopy Spread
vegetative.description: Rapid stem elongation and foliage building.

flowering.label: Flowering / Early Setting
flowering.description: Extremely sensitive to moisture deficits and high heat.

fruiting.label: Bell Expansion
fruiting.description: Fruit wall thickness development; requires frequent light irrigations.

maturity.label: Color Break / Harvest
maturity.description: Green to yellow/red pigment conversion; maintain moderate soil moisture.

initial.label: Bahar Initiation / New Flush
initial.description: Resumption of watering after mandatory stress/withholding period (hasta/ambe/mrig bahar).

vegetative.label: Vegetative Flush & Flowering
vegetative.description: Flush of bisexual flowers and rapid shoot growth.

flowering.label: Fruit Set & Early Development
flowering.description: Califlower stage to small fruitlet formation; regulated drip is essential.

fruiting.label: Fruit Growth / Aril Filling
fruiting.description: Maximum water demand; moisture fluctuations cause catastrophic rind cracking.

maturity.label: Maturity / Harvest
maturity.description: Sugar accumulation and rind coloring; taper off irrigation.

initial.label: Planting / Early Shoot
initial.description: Sword sucker / tissue culture establishment; high shallow water requirement.

vegetative.label: Grand Vegetative Growth
vegetative.description: Huge broad leaf area index; high constant transpiration rate.

flowering.label: Shooting / Inflorescence Emergence
flowering.description: Bunch emergence from pseudostem; moisture stress reduces hand/finger count.

fruiting.label: Bunch Development & Filling
fruiting.description: Fingers swell and round off; requires copious uniform drip supply.

maturity.label: Bunch Harvest
maturity.description: Ripening harvest flushes prior to ratoon crop preparation.

initial.label: Germination / Emergence
initial.description: Sprouting of setts and early root development.

vegetative.label: Tillering & Formative Stage
vegetative.description: Tillering and leaf canopy buildup; critical water requirement.

flowering.label: Grand Growth / Cane Elongation
flowering.description: Peak internode elongation and maximum water consumption.

maturity.label: Ripening & Harvest
maturity.description: Taper off water 20-30 days before cutting to concentrate sucrose brix.
